summary: Jan–Apr 2026 yield 5.81 t/ha, up 16.9% on Jan–Apr 2025 (4.97) (Agro Table 15), but harvesting still runs beyond 20 days.
Jan–Dec 2025 FFB 34,353 t (15.88 t/ha), 23% below budget of 20.54 t/ha because of a harvester shortage (PA).
Only 84 of 94 harvesters at Dec 2025, falling to 73 by Apr 2026 (Agro); high turnover and low earnings are the root issue.
Jan–Dec 2025 cost of production RM254.64/t FFB, below budget RM262.36/t; general charges 30% and upkeep 22% underspent.
Pruning backlog (49% of 2025 programme) and rat damage in PR23I (22%) need urgent action.

issues.title: 2024 yield baseline conflicts
issues.detail: PA says 2025 yield 15.88 t/ha was 12% higher than 2024 (14.12 t/ha, 32,943.6 t FFB). Agro Table 13 says it was 13% lower than 2024 (18.29 t/ha); Agro Appendix 2(a) gives 2024 as 16.04 t/ha and the monthly record gives 42,643.13 t for 2024. The PA prior-year FFB is about 9,700 t lower than the Agro record. Also PA's own prior-year figures do not reconcile: 32,943.6 t / 2,445.93 ha = 13.47 t/ha, not 14.12.

issues.title: EFB application 2025 differs threefold
issues.detail: PA: 65,336.46 t EFB on 1,306.73 ha (78% of 1,677.40 ha). Agro Table 8: 21,174.61 t on 423.49 ha (25%). By field, P96D 579.12 ha (201% of area) in PA vs 298.85 ha (104%) in Agro; P97E and P02F 138.54 and 183.94 ha in PA vs 0 in Agro.

issues.title: Labour total variance wrong
issues.detail: PA labour statement shows total variance -41, but Dec 2025 available 148 vs required 171 is -23. The printed category variances sum to -22 (-23 once Loader is corrected from +5 to +4, since 7 vs 3 is +4).

issues.title: Cost per tonne CPO figures wrong
issues.detail: PA Cost of Production RM/t CPO: harvesting actual 433.40 but RM2,303,662 / 6,524.65 t CPO = 353.07; harvesting budget 422.50 vs 352.74; general charges budget 214.74 vs RM4,342,875 / 8,420.93 t = 515.72. The total actual 1,421.09 RM/t CPO is therefore overstated (about 1,340.76 on corrected harvesting).

issues.title: Manuring summary 2025 arithmetic
issues.detail: Agro Table 5: applied column sums to 1,795.38 t but total shown 1,532.96 t; CRF 19.98 t applied vs 13.82 t required shown as 92% (actually 145%); CIRP 136.60 vs 125.60 t shown 100%. Agro itself asks the estate to explain over/under-application of Mix A, NK1, RP and CRF.

issues.title: Harvester count and requirement
issues.detail: PA: 84 harvesters vs 94 required (Dec 2025). Agro: 73 harvesters in Apr 2026 'representing only 73% of the required workforce', implying 100 required; 73 of 94 would be 78%.

issues.title: Immature RM/ha divisor errors
issues.detail: PA PR24J table: RM467,493 shown as 979.04 RM/ha, but over 255.12 ha it is about 1,832; PR25K: RM157,750 shown as 330.37 RM/ha, but over 168.35 ha it is about 937. Both appear divided by 477.5 ha (I+J combined). Printed totals per ha are affected: PR24J 2,345 (816,004 / 255.12 is about 3,198) and PR25K 10,721 (1,906,933 / 168.35 is about 11,327).

issues.title: Table 13 P96B 2024 yield
issues.detail: Agro Table 13 shows P96B 2024 yield 13.94 t/ha and 2025 13.85 t/ha with a -15.1% difference; -15.1% only fits the Appendix 2(a) 2024 figure of 16.32 t/ha (6,539.77 t over 400.82 ha). The other six blocks' Table 13 2024 yields match Appendix 2(a). The dashboard uses 16.32 as P96B prior-year. Table 13 also lists 2,444.55 ha though its rows sum to 2,331.66 ha.

issues.title: Block yields do not tie to estate total
issues.detail: Agro Table 13 2025 block yields multiplied by the Table 13 hectares sum to about 36,685 t (arithmetic check), against 34,353.43 t FFB reported for 2025 (Appendix 2(b)); the estate 15.88 t/ha is on 2,163.31 ha, while Table 13 lists 2,444.55 ha.

issues.title: Barn owl census arithmetic
issues.detail: Agro Table 11: occupied 132 + unoccupied 66 = 198 vs 189 boxes; P02F 31 + 18 = 49 vs 40 boxes; 132/189 = 70% not 65%; area total 2,281.07 ha vs rows 2,112.72 ha.

issues.title: PR25K planting completion date
issues.detail: PA 10.3.2: planting completed February 2026. Agro 7.3.1: planting completed December 2025.

issues.title: Rat baiting threshold differs
issues.detail: PA uses a 10% damage threshold for baiting; Agro 5.5.2 says baiting only above 20% for mature areas (10% for P20H and immature).

issues.title: Replanting area total
issues.detail: Agro 2.4/Table 3 gives the 2027 replant as 125.17 ha (B4–B8), but the Table 3 sub-blocks listed (26.71+53.82+14.51+22.94+7.39) sum to 125.37 ha. Table 2 blocking lists P96B as B1–B7 only (B3 = 26.51 ha, B3–B7 sum to 125.17 ha), so Table 3 labels look shifted by one block; PA area statement lists B1–B9.

issues.title: Manuring 2026 table total
issues.detail: Agro Table 7: applied rows sum to 633.57 t but the total is printed as 634.57 t (40%). Section 3.5 says the remaining fertiliser types completed the first round, yet CIRP shows 0.35 of 165.52 t applied.

issues.title: Immature fertiliser programme heading
issues.detail: Agro Appendix 1(e) is headed '2025 fertilizer programme for immature plantings', but includes PR25K compound due Aug 2026 (7.3.2), so it is unclear whether the doses are the 2025 or 2026 programme.

actions.item: Recruit and retain harvesters; review harvesting rates so harvesters earn above minimum wage
Cut harvesting interval to under 15 days (two rounds a month)
Clear pruning backlog in P96B, P96C, P96D and P03G
Raise sprayer productivity to 5–6 ha/man-day, use CDA, review RM20/ha piece rate
Apply fertiliser 5–6 ft from palm base
Explain 2025 fertiliser over/under-application (Mix A, NK1, RP, CRF)
Post-baiting rat census in PR23I; quarterly rat census in P20H and mature areas
Repair or replace barn owl boxes (65% occupancy)
Control Apogonia in PR24J and do 2 rounds of ablation
Complete PR24J supplying (PA table: by June 2026; PA text and Agro: within 2026)
Eradicate VOPs in all immature areas
Level and compact machine paths in PR23I
Deter monkey damage at P20H hilltop
Complete palm census, prioritising young mature and immature areas
Estate Manager to explain general charges over-expenditure sub-codes
Eradicate Ageratum in palm circles of P97E and P02F (and PR23I)
Avoid fertiliser delays over three months; platform-based rat census in mature areas (none in Q1 2026)
Eradicate Mucuna climbing palms at P20H hilltop with Ally 40 g/pump by mist blower

kb:
LADANG SUNGAI ENGGANG (Ria Gemilang Sdn Bhd, Prosper group). General Manager Mr Lee Chong Yew; Senior Manager En. Mohd Safirun bin Mohd Azba; Estate Managers Tn. Hj. Mohd Rasul Bin Ghazali and En. Shukor Bin Yusoff (Shukor transferred to Sg. Sisik Estate from Feb 2026; Assistant Zambri Bin Mohammad made Assistant in charge from Feb 2026). Planting Advisor Mr Boey Chee Weng. Agronomists En. Ghazali Abd Ghani (Junior) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior).

SOURCES. PA = Planting Advisory Report 1/2026, visit 25 May 2026, period reviewed Jan to Dec 2025. Agro = Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 21 May 2026 (previous visit 16 Dec 2025), programme 2026.

AREA (PA). Mature 2,163.31 ha: P96 B1-B9 232.47, P96 C1-C10 528.12, P96 D1-D9 411.56, P97 E1-E10 416.48, P02 F1-F5 401.47, P03 G1-G2 122.62, PM20 H1 50.59. Immature 645.85 ha: PRM23I 222.38, PRM24J 255.12, PR25K 168.35. Total oil palm 2,809.16 ha. Housing 9.11, Mill 12.71, Biogas 1.05, Pond 1.00. Total estate 2,833.03 ha. No replanting in 2026. Agro: P96B was 400.82 ha before part was replanted as PR25K. Agro age profile (Jan 2026 area 2,809.16 ha: 645.85 ha 0-3 years, 50.59 ha 4-7, 524.09 ha 20-25, 1,588.63 ha over 26): 23% immature/new replant, 2% (50.59 ha) aged 4-7, 19% aged 20-25, 57% over 26 years. Agro tentative replanting: 2027 B4, B5, B6, B7, B8 = 125.17 ha (Table 3 sub-blocks as printed sum to 125.37 ha; Table 2 lists B1-B7 only with B3 26.51 ha and B3-B7 = 125.17 ha, so Table 3 labels look shifted) (4.5% of estate, undulating to hilly); 2028 B1, B2 = 107.30 ha (3.8%). Agro palm census in P96D under way: D1 6,540 palms (125 SPH, previously 132), D2 5,415 (132 vs 137), D3 5,516 (132 vs 140), D4 5,431 (136 vs 140), D5 6,677 (134 vs 140), D6 5,533 (138 vs 145), D7 6,568 (120 vs 127), D8 6,964 (131 vs 145), D9 5,217 (133 vs 148). Census recommended for young mature and immature areas first.

LABOUR (PA, Dec 2025, required vs available). Harvester 94 vs 84 (short 10; ratio 1:23 ha required, 1:26 actual), Driver FFB 9 vs 5, Loader 3 vs 7, Manuring 15 vs 7, Weeding 31 vs 27, Mandore 6 vs 4, Driver EFB 7 vs 5, Watchman 6 vs 7, General workers 0 vs 2. Total 171 vs 148 (report prints variance -41; the arithmetic gives -23). Harvesters by month 2025: 71, 70, 67, 60, 61, 62, 58, 57, 49, 64, 70, 84. Sprayers short 4, manuring short 8. Worker ratio 1:15 ha vs ideal 1:14. Agro: April 2026 progress report shows 73 harvesters, 73% of requirement. High turnover of harvesters is the main concern; harvesters' low income drives it.

STAFF (PA). Managers Tn. Haji Mohd Rasul (joined 15.06.2023) and Tn. Shukor (05.05.2024). Assistant Managers Zambri Bin Mohammad and Mohamad Zaim Haiqal; one vacancy. Eight field conductors, office clerk, storekeeper. Staff adequate.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA, to Dec 2025). Actual RM3,055,686.36 vs budget RM4,342,875 (RM1,087.76/ha vs RM1,545.97/ha), underspent 30%. Management and supervision RM1,360,396 (484.27/ha) vs 1,808,348; Labour and amenities RM572,330 vs 888,791; Other RM1,122,960 vs 1,645,736. Some sub-codes overspent but could not be explained as Chief Clerk was absent.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION MATURE (PA, to Dec 2025, RM and RM/ha). Weeding 433,095 (200.20/ha) vs 490,540 (226.75). Manuring 2,421,314 (1,119.26) vs 2,912,717 (1,346.42). Pest and disease 29,972 (13.85) vs 12,904 (5.96), overspent. Census 0 vs 11,586. Drains 135,326 (62.56) vs 211,767 (97.89). Roads 195,744 (90.48) vs 304,934 (140.96). Bridges 21,299 (9.85) vs 126,400 (58.43). Pruning 151,702 (70.12) vs 273,831 (126.58). Total 3,388,630 (1,566.41/ha) vs 4,344,679 (2,008.35/ha), underspent 22%.

CIRCLE SPRAYING (PA). 5,424.12 ha (2.5 rounds) or 84% of 6,489.93 ha (3 rounds) to Dec 2025; high rainfall interrupted. By field: B 95%, C 65%, D 71%, E 100%, F 100%, G 67%, H 100%. Circles clean except block F; circles too small, advise 6 ft radius. Output 3.7 ha/man-day, could reach 5. Piece rate RM20/ha, average earning RM74/man-day; should be about RM15/ha at 5 ha/man-day. Glyphosate 0.22 l/ha (1.1 pump/ha). Mucuna climbing palms at P20/H1 hilltop, eradicate with Ally 40 g/pump by mist blower.
SELECTIVE SPRAYING (PA). 5,811.71 ha (2.7 rounds) or 90% of 6,489.93 ha to Dec 2025. B 68%, C 78%, D 97%, E 100%, F 100%, G 81%, H 100%. Mist blowers, 3.7 ha/man-day, could reach 6. Garlon 0.41 l/ha and Ally 0.04 kg/ha; advised to drop Ally.
Agro weeding: 2025 programme completed; Jan-Apr 2026 inter-row done in all old mature areas, circles still in progress in P97E and P02F where Ageratum conyzoides persists; P96C circles slightly overgrown.

MANURING 2025. PA: 72 of 72 rounds applied (100%). Methods: tractor/trailer 1,346 ha at 30 bags/man-day, RM2.50/bag; Badang 584 ha RM2.20/bag; broadcasting 233 ha peat RM2.20/bag. Fertiliser applied too close to palm base, advised 5-6 ft away. Agro Table 5: Mix A 233.05 of 236.70 t (98%), Mix B 207.20 (100%), NK1 560.00 of 550.45 (102%), NK2 433.30 (100%), CIRP 136.60 of 125.60, CRF 19.98 of 13.82, AS Kali 205.25 of 195.05; total required 1,762.12 t, total shown applied 1,532.96 t (rows sum 1,795.38). Agro notes discrepancies in Mix A, NK1, RP and CRF and delays: Mix B P20H rd 4 Aug applied Nov; F2-F4 Mix B rd 2 Apr applied Jul; Mix A F2/F3 rd 1 Jan applied Jun/Apr; NK2 C5, C7, C8 rd 1 applied May. Delays over three months to be avoided.
MANURING 2026 (Agro Table 7, to date). Required 1,558.75 t, received 844.50 t, applied 634.57 t (40%; applied rows sum to 633.57 t). Mix A 133.15 of 339.36 (38%), Mix B 29.50 of 73.94 (40%), NK1 194.50 of 385.99 (50%), NK2 215.65 of 216.65 (100%), CIRP 0.35 of 165.52 (0%), CRF 0.42 of 1.64 (26%), Compound A 30 of 205.66 (15%), Compound B 30 of 171.63 (17%). Storage on pallets improved. Quality check in PR24J2: Compound A at 1.0 kg/palm, 80 bags by 3 applicators, 26-27 bags each, acceptable.
REVISED 2026 PROGRAMME (Agro Appendix 1, grams per palm). P96B B1-B2 NK2 2250 (one round; appendix months not legible so omitted); B3-B8 to be replanted 2027. P96C NK2 2500 single round. P96D NK1 2000 then NK1 1500 (D1-D4, D6) or 2000 (D5, D7-D9). P97E NK1 2000 x 2; E1, E2, E4 on hold due to land dispute. P02F Mix A 2250, 2000, 2000; F1 on hold due to land dispute. P03G Mix A 2250, Mix B 2250, Mix A 2000. P20H Mix B 1750, RP 2000, Mix B 1750, Mix B 1500, Mix B 1500. Immature (Appendix 1(e), headed 2025 programme): PR23I Comp B 1200, 1500, RP 1750, Comp B 1500, 1500. PR24J Comp A 1000, 1000, RP 1750. PR25K CRF 600 and RP 500 at planting, then Comp A 800, RP 1500, Comp A 900. 2027 programme to be drawn up in second half 2026. Mix A = 45% AS, 40% MOP, 15% kieserite; Mix B adds 1% borate; NK1 50% AS 50% MOP; NK2 60% SOA 40% MOP.

EFB 2025. PA: 65,336.46 t on 1,306.73 ha, 78% of 1,677.40 ha budgeted, at 50 t/ha; contractor package RM10.83/t, 150 t/day; spread one layer between 4 palms, satisfactory. Agro: 21,174.61 t on 423.49 ha, 25% of area, 50 t/ha (P96B 49.48 ha, P96D 298.85 ha, P03G 75.19 ha, others nil). The two reports disagree.

PRUNING (PA). 8,398 ha of 17,306 ha programme (49%) to Dec 2025: B 29%, C 16%, D 11%, E 100%, F 93%, G 38%, H 38%. Shortfall due to harvester shortage. Cost per palm per year RM0.89 (1993/96/97), RM0.77 (2002/03), RM0.50 (2020). Estate Manager says no corrective pruning needed in 2026. Agro: most blocks under 50% in 2025; under-pruning in P03G, P96C, P96D; P96B unsatisfactory, excess fronds should still be removed; P02F and P97E acceptable.

PEST AND DISEASE. PA: old rat damage at P20, bait if over 10%; severe monkey damage at hilltop near jungle; bagworm trunk injection with Methamidophos along main road at E4, E5, E6 and F2; no new bagworm. Agro: 2025 quarterly rat damage census 4.3% to 6.8% in all mature fields, below threshold; no Q1 2026 census; Agro says baiting in mature areas only when platform census damage exceeds 20%. 189 barn owl boxes, 65% occupancy in April 2026 (P03G 29%); one box per 11 ha adequate; repair or replace boxes. Bagworm in P96B treated May 2025 by trunk injection with Adonis (Acephate 97%) 8 g/palm. Ganoderma negligible.

HARVESTING AND COLLECTION (PA, to Dec 2025). Harvesting labour RM1,671,592 (RM48.66/t) vs RM2,172,205 (48.89); internal collection RM632,070 (18.40/t) vs 798,226 (17.96); total RM2,303,662 (67.06/t) vs RM2,970,431 (66.85/t). Internal transport higher due to 4% diesel subsidy. 2025 harvesting rounds 16.6 vs budget 24. Current interval averages 20 days. Outturn 94%. 6 Badang units (4 cutters + 1 collector) and 6 mini-tractors (7 cutters + 1 collector). Harvesting rates per ton: PM96, PM97, PM02 RM32; PM03 RM25; PM20 RM75. Output t/man-day: PM96 1.79, PM97 2.86, PM02 2.07, PM03 1.64, PM20 0.68; average earnings RM57.28, 91.52, 66.24, 41.00, 51.00 vs basic wage RM65.39 - many harvesters below minimum wage. Agro: 2025 intervals often over 20 days due to palms over 50 ft, shortage of skilled tall-palm harvesters and turnover; many over-ripe bunches in D3, D4, F1, G2; loose fruit collection suboptimal; target under 15 days. 2025 cumulative rounds (Agro Table 14): P96B 11.58 (48%), P96C 17.60 (73%), P96D 14.58 (61%), P97E 15.24 (64%), P02F 16.20 (68%), P03G 18.50 (77%), P20H 23.00 (96%). To April 2026: B 5.32 (67%), C 5.10 (64%), D 6.44 (81%), E 5.86 (73%), F 6.60 (83%), G 7.50 (94%), H 10.00 (125%).

CROP PRODUCTION (PA, to Dec 2025, 2,163.31 ha). FFB 34,353.43 t vs budget 44,433 t; CPO 6,524.65 t vs 8,420.93; kernel 1,716.07 t. OER 18.99% (budget 18.95), KER 5.00%. Yield 15.88 t FFB/ha vs 20.54 budget (23% below); CPO 3.02 t/ha vs 3.89. PA last year same period 32,943.6 t FFB, 14.12 t/ha (on 2,445.93 ha; 32,943.6 / 2,445.93 = 13.47, so 14.12 does not reconcile), so PA says 2025 was 12% higher. Bunch weights Dec 2024 vs Dec 2025: B 21.9 to 20.6 kg, C 20.2 to 18.2, D 25.7 to 22.2, E 23.3 to 22.2, F 18.5 to 18.8, G 19.1 to 18.9, H 3.84 to 5.5 kg; decline put down to over-ripe bunches. P20 hilltop: high supplies, poor fruit set.
YIELD (Agro Table 13, full years Jan-Dec 2024 vs Jan-Dec 2025, t/ha): P96B 13.94 printed vs 13.85 (-15.1% printed; Agro Appendix 2(a) gives 16.32 for 2024 P96B, which is what fits -15.1%; the other blocks' 2024 figures match Appendix 2(a); 2025 on 400.82 ha basis), P96C 15.90 vs 13.05, P96D 17.07 vs 14.16, P97E 23.05 vs 21.53, P02F 19.23 vs 17.12, P03G 21.86 vs 18.45, P20H 5.53 vs 6.17, total 18.29 vs 15.88 (-13.2%). Agro says 2025 yield fell 13% and only P20H rose. Jan-Apr 2026 (Agro Table 15) 5.81 t/ha vs 4.97 in Jan-Apr 2025 (+16.90%): B 6.43, C 5.03, D 5.52, E 7.09, F 5.81, G 5.03, H 3.29. Monthly FFB 2026: Jan 3,201.64, Feb 2,954.36, Mar 3,014.98, Apr 3,388.18 t; total 12,559.16 t. Annual FFB (Agro Appendix 2): 2020 54,978.06 t; 2021 41,079.43 (15.75 t/ha); 2022 39,062.94 (14.98); 2023 41,874.13 (15.75; monthly record total 41,887.31); 2024 42,643.13 (16.04); 2025 34,353.43.

COST OF PRODUCTION (PA, RM/t FFB, to Dec 2025). General charges 88.94 vs 97.73; upkeep 98.64 vs 97.78; harvesting and collection 67.06 vs 66.85; total 254.64 vs 262.36. RM/t CPO total printed 1,421.09 vs 1,153.18 (some CPO-basis figures do not reconcile). Cost acceptable despite yield shortfall.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA). 2,910 of 6,675 chains graded to Dec 2025 at RM10/chain; road condition satisfactory. 270 of 1,900 t crusher run bought (RM40.50-45.00/t). Drains desilted: 15x10x8 ft 278 of 290 ch; 12x8x6 533 of 612; 8x6x4 1,593.73 of 2,966; 5x4x3 1,004 of 2,285.

IMMATURE. PR23I (222.38 ha): 2025 upkeep RM519,181 (RM2,335/ha) vs RM551,462 budget; cost from start RM3,491,578 (RM15,701/ha). Circle spraying 97%, selective 100%, 5 of 5 fertiliser rounds, 3 rounds rat baiting, 1,600 palms supplied (complete). Basal pruning since Feb 2026, 172 ha done, finish June 2026; scout harvesting since Feb 2026 with wheelbarrows; machine paths very uneven. Agro: palms about 29 months, healthy, acceptable bunches; 2026 inter-row 2 of 4 rounds, circle 1 of 4; Ageratum and Asystasia in circles; herbicide overspray on camber bunds; rat damage 22% overall (I1 10%, I2 27%, I3 27%, I4 22%; 6,657 of 30,102 palms; SPH 135); baiting with Butik G2 bromadiolone; post-census and 7-day follow-up baiting if needed; Apogonia and rhinoceros beetle down.
PR24J (255.12 ha): 2025 upkeep RM467,493 vs RM503,949 (PA prints RM979.04/ha; over 255.12 ha it is about RM1,832/ha); total incl. development RM816,004; cost from start RM3,187,544. Circle 78% (6 of 8 rounds), selective 98%, fertiliser 3 of 3 rounds, 24 rounds Cypermethrin for Oryctes, no supplying yet (to finish in 2026). Agro: palms about 15 months, uniformity improved; CIRP applied Dec instead of Sep 2025; 2 rounds ablation 5-6 weeks apart before scout harvesting; inter-row 1 of 6, circle 2 of 6 rounds to Apr 2026; significant localised Apogonia damage.
PR25K (168.35 ha): 2025 cost RM1,906,933 vs RM2,227,586 budget (PA prints upkeep RM330.37/ha; RM157,750 over 168.35 ha is about RM937/ha), mainly terracing RM723,464 and planting material RM719,277. PA: planted in low-lying and ex-tapping-right hilly areas; planting completed Feb 2026; VOPs remain; more supplying needed; manuring due Aug 2026. Agro: planting completed Dec 2025; CRF 600 g and RP 500 g in planting hole; Mucuna at 300 points/ha; EFB planned in circles on camber bunds in one layer; minimal rats; broadleaf weeds, VOPs, Hedyotis and Solanum to be eradicated.

VEHICLES AND CAPEX (PA). Hilux BRL 9181 and NDY 1918 running RM0.34 and 0.33/km vs 0.57 budget. Capex budget RM905,150; all capex transferred to Prosper Group so not shown.

RAINFALL (Agro). 2022 3,604.7 mm/191 days; 2023 4,359.0/196; 2024 3,264.0/142; 2025 4,086.05/151 (Dec 2025 1,204 mm); 2026 Jan-Apr 655.8 mm/31 days.

PA CONCLUSIONS. High harvester turnover; need adequate field upkeep workers for immature areas; mature field condition well controlled, raise sprayer productivity; eradicate VOPs in immature areas; expedite delayed pruning. Agro conclusions: harvesting interval and under-pruning are the two key issues; rats in young and immature plantings need monitoring.
blockSrc: Agronomy Report 1/2026 Table 13 (P96B 2024 comparison from Appendix 2(a), see issues)
